caption: The video captures a wide valley landscape at golden hour, viewed from an elevated vantage with dark tree tops at the bottom edge. A patchwork of fields stretches toward a low ridge of hills on the right horizon, broken by a small reflective patch in the mid-distance. Heavy clouds fill the upper frame, and the sun breaks through to cast a luminous yellow-white glow. Several crepuscular rays slant downward over the valley, keeping the same orientation throughout the clip. The camera stays fixed, so the foreground trees, valley features, and horizon hold their positions without pan, tilt, or zoom. The only visible change is a subtle, slow fluctuation of the sun's glow, while the cloud shapes and the rays themselves remain largely unchanged. This quiet shimmer of light persists across the scene.
